passages.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
passages.sermon:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write this letter.
They write to the church of the Thessalonians.
This church belongs to God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy greet the church.
They wish grace and peace to the Thessalonians.
passages.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη

passages.text: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
passages.sermon:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the church of the Thessalonians.
This church is in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
We always thank God for all of you.
We remember you in our prayers.
We do not stop thinking of you before our God and Father.
We remember your work that comes from faith.
We remember your labor that comes from love.
We remember your endurance that comes from hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
passages.original: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενοι ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν ἡμῶν ἀδιαλείπτως μνημονεύοντες ὑμῶν τοῦ ἔργου τῆς πίστεως καὶ τοῦ κόπου τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ τῆς ὑπομονῆς τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν

passages.text: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you, because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
passages.sermon:
You are brothers.
God loves you.
God has chosen you.
We know this.
Our gospel came to you.
It did not come only in words.
It came in power.
It came in the Holy Spirit.
It came with great conviction.
You know how we lived among you.
We lived this way for your sake.
passages.original: εἰδότες ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν ἐκλογὴν ὑμῶν ὅτι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν λόγῳ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν δυνάμει καὶ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πολλῇ καθὼς οἴδατε οἷοι ἐγενήθημεν ἐν ὑμῖν δι’ ὑμᾶς

passages.text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
passages.sermon:
You became imitators of us.
You also became imitators of the Lord.
You welcomed the message.
You suffered greatly.
You received the message with joy.
The Holy Spirit gave you this joy.
passages.original: Καὶ ὑμεῖς μιμηταὶ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθητε καὶ τοῦ Κυρίου δεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον ἐν θλίψει πολλῇ μετὰ χαρᾶς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου

passages.text: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
passages.sermon:
You have become an example.
All believers in Macedonia see your example.
All believers in Achaia see your example.
You show others how to live as believers.
passages.original: ὥστε γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς τύπον πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ

passages.text: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
passages.sermon:
The message of the Lord went out from you.
It reached Macedonia.
It reached Achaia.
Your faith in God spread everywhere.
People in every place heard about your faith.
We do not need to say anything more.
passages.original: ἀφ’ ὑμῶν γὰρ ἐξήχηται ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν ἡ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ἐξελήλυθεν ὥστε μὴ χρείαν ἔχειν ἡμᾶς λαλεῖν τι

passages.text: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
passages.sermon:
People themselves report about us.
They tell what kind of welcome you gave us.
They say you turned to God from idols.
You now serve the living and true God.
You wait for His Son from heaven.
God raised His Son from the dead.
His Son is Jesus.
Jesus rescues us from the coming wrath.
passages.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ περὶ ἡμῶν ἀπαγγέλλουσιν ὁποίαν εἴσοδον ἔσχομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ πῶς ἐπεστρέψατε πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων δουλεύειν Θεῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἀληθινῷ καὶ ἀναμένειν τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦν τὸν ῥυόμενον ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ὀργῆς τῆς ἐρχομένης
